notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes:
Improvements and corrections based on your feedback

We want to thank all the players who have joined us in these first days. Your feedback has been invaluable to us, and we are excited to present the following improvements and corrections:

Fixed a transcription error on the unlock screen.

Resolved an issue that caused the game to crash on the "Cryos" level.

Improved the range and damage of the knife attack, so you can face your enemies more effectively.

Increased damage from all aerial attacks and increased the appearance of Medkits, to make Aerial Attack more attractive and rewarding.


Your opinion is fundamental to us. Don't hesitate to share your suggestions and comments to keep improving!

Countdown to version 1.0

We're getting closer to version 1.0 and we want to thank you for your continued support. Leave us your comments and suggestions! Your feedback is essential for us to keep improving.

notes.title: Update 0.44: New Features and Improvements
notes.notes:
New update available!

Respec your perk points: Now you can respec your perk points as you wish. Experiment with different combinations or transfer all your points to another character. The choice is yours.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193396/d525e544846275ae2557b91cbab693fc77418c60.png

Keep playing without interruptions: If your character dies and you don't complete the missions, don't worry. You can assign points, make modifications or change characters without having to return to the main menu. Keep playing without pause!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193396/54ae982929612e96c1f806b97ab43fde56fe78f3.png

More freedom and agility: These improvements allow you to test each character without having to complete several games to collect points. Enjoy a more fluid and personalized gaming experience!

Moving towards version 1.0: We continue working hard to reach the final version. Thank you for your support and for following us on this journey!

Share your comments and suggestions!: Your opinion is invaluable to us. Keep letting us know what you like and what we could improve!

notes.title: Update 0.13: New Additions and Improvements!

I am pleased to announce the arrival of Update 0.13, another step on our way to version 1.0.

6 new weapons have been added to the game's arsenal. Each of them offers unique characteristics and gameplay styles, expanding the strategic possibilities on the battlefield.

notes.title: Update 0.02 is now live!
notes.notes:
5 new weapons to unlock!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193396/a00072b22926e9aa91a2b00160b80a010c1b10b1.png

It's been a week since launch!

During this first week, my top priority has been to quickly identify and fix any bugs that impact the gameplay experience. Thanks to your feedback, I've been able to address many issues without a hitch. Additionally, we've added a borderless fullscreen option, a highly requested feature from the community.

My other priority is to gather your initial impressions of the game. I want to know which elements are working well and which ones need improvement. One aspect I've highlighted is the need for each character to have unique traits that set them apart from the others.

To address this, I'm already working on a bonus system. As players eliminate enemies, special and unique powers will be unlocked for each character, which will also boost experience during the game. I'll be sharing more information about the progress of this system soon.

Finally, I just want to thank everyone. Thank you so much to those who leave their feedback! It's incredibly important for us to keep moving forward.

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I'm Nicolás, the developer behind EON Trooper.

Undertaking a project of this magnitude on my own is no easy task, especially with a tight budget. Feedback is one of the most crucial aspects of development, and often, obtaining it can be challenging. The lack of objective feedback can sometimes leave us blind to mistakes or misguided decisions regarding gameplay.

The goal of any development is for players to fully enjoy the experience.

Over the past few days, thanks to the feedback received, I've decided to implement significant changes in the gameplay. Meanwhile, I continue to work on new scenarios, enemies, weapons, and more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193396/31710e69901d13bdb661765b669bc75681163ac9.png

One of the main changes is to grant players greater freedom in their approach. The risk of triggering alarms has been removed, except when completing objectives. Additionally, I've significantly increased the available ammunition and the number of enemies, as well as the damage they inflict.

With these modifications, the game leans more towards direct action. Even though damage intake and the number of enemies have increased, the lack of alarms and the abundance of ammunition allow players to face challenges with more flexibility. It's still possible to pursue a stealth strategy, but now the gameplay is faster and more dynamic.

I hope these adjustments enhance the experience and make it more thrilling. As always, I appreciate your comments, critiques, and suggestions.

Thank you all so much for your support!

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Based on initial feedback, the following changes have been made:

Bullet speed has been significantly reduced and their size increased, making them much more visible, allowing players to better position themselves to avoid damage.

The alarm sensitivity has been greatly decreased. It is now possible to engage in more extensive conflicts without having to constantly pay attention to the alarm level. However, if the alarm is triggered, the number of enemies has increased.

In this update, you'll notice changes that could notably alter the gameplay. It's essential to understand that these changes are a direct reflection of your feedback. Every comment, suggestion, and critique you share guides and aids me in refining and improving the game.

I continue to listen to you all, learning from your feedback, and working tirelessly to make EON Trooper a better experience.

Thank you, BlackjackGT, Scottbaylo, Forestcrunk!

notes.title: EON Fighter: Version 1.0 now available!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193396/b8f803078636202e954b167faa237721b15d070d.png

The awaited day has come! I'm pleased to announce that EON Fighter has reached its full 1.0 version on Steam. I want to extend a deep thank you to every player who has accompanied me on this journey, offering their unwavering support and allowing me to grow at every stage of development.

This year has been a whirlwind of emotions, filled with learnings, challenges, and the fortune of crossing paths with extraordinary people. I'm more motivated than ever, and I believe that EON Fighter is just the beginning of many more adventures to share.

I sincerely hope you enjoy the game and, as always, I'm open and attentive to your valuable feedback.

Thank you for being a part of this story!
